verdict.rationale: Salesmate is a CRM SaaS platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server, though. It shows only REST APIs and general integration support, which are developer building blocks rather than an MCP server, plus in-product AI agents, which are a different feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
